# Documentation coverage review — September 22 to October 22, 2026

PSA source snapshot: `3998b5595dc780238562e3413e7b3f4ed42d25c2`. Docs base: merged AP PR #4 (`e6809e6`).
Cutoff: September 22, 2026 at 00:00 America/New_York, through the review snapshot on October 22. The latest included merge is October 21. The inventory follows the main branch first-parent merge history; work merged through stacked branches is reviewed in the mainline merge that actually delivered it.

## Scope and publication

This record maps every included merge to reviewed documentation or an explicit exclusion. It is excluded from the Mintlify website because it lives in `.github/`. Private PSA PR links are reviewer evidence, not links placed in customer guides. No credentials, customer records, exploit details or internal roadmap text are copied here.

The review describes merged code, not a live-provider acceptance test. Zoho Books and vault TOTP remain rollout-dependent; catalogs, routing, invoice review and billing schedules retain their opt-in behavior. Unimplemented roadmap items (including OData/Power BI, full calendar pull sync and automatic charges) are not advertised as available.

## Source verification

Each inventory entry was compared using the merge diff against its first parent and the commits introduced by its second parent. The working inventory also records touched source paths. Detailed final behavior was checked against the current route/UI/helper code and the architecture records for ticket workflows, catalog approvals/fulfilment, lifecycle metrics/SLA, accounting sync, calendar, policy templates and vault/authentication.

## Validation

The refresh changes **45 MDX pages**, including **9 new guide/release pages**, plus navigation and this coverage record (**47 files** total).

- All **83 MDX pages** compiled with `@mdx-js/mdx` 3.1.1.
- All **83 navigation entries**, **420 internal links** and referenced headings resolved, including preserved AP and older priority-section anchors.
- The webhook verification example passed **7 checks** against the production signer: current and overlap keys accepted; immediate rotation rejected the old key; changed body, stale timestamp, malformed and missing headers rejected.
- All existing heading anchors in edited guides were retained, including compatibility anchors where wording changed. The documented **10 API scopes** and **18 outbound webhook events** match production source. JSON examples parse successfully.
- `git diff --check` passed. Only the docs repository is changed; no PSA runtime, migration, credentials or provider operations are modified.

No live-provider requests or production deployment were used for this documentation review. Merge/publish this docs PR to make the new guides available on the public site.
